Intro: Old Aijinkova may be dead, but her people live on. Be proud of what you all have become.
Serve me [DISH], if you may. Motherland be Proud, Motherland be Strong.
Success: I am blessed to taste your cooking once more, friend.
Fail: Have you changed your tools? You adapt well, but this is just absurd. I am disappointed, cook…
Reject: I see. Too many customers? Or have you made a deal with the witch? Liar! Musor!
